title: From Kirk Cousins saving Vikings' defense to Chargers ignoring reality, NFL trade deadline winners and losers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: From Kirk Cousins saving Vikings' defense to Chargers ignoring reality, NFL trade deadline winners and losers
sources.description: Many in Minnesota win with Cousins' arrival. Justin Jefferson no doubt is breathing a little more easily after the news. Meanwhile, the Chargers' passivity is the latest reason to question Jim Harbaugh's grand plan.
